{!$Input:Content}
Instructions: "The following email contains one or more job descriptions. Separate each job description, and return a list of structured JSON objects as defined above, one for each role."
You will receive one or more job descriptions in plain text format.
There may be one job description or multiple.
Give skill types like soft skill, technical skill, etc.
For each job description:
Extract and structure the data into the following JSON format:
{ "Company_Name__c": [Company name mentioned], "Contact": [Contact name if mentioned], "Email": [Email if mentioned], "Phone": [Phone if mentioned], "AR__c": [AR value as a number, if mentioned], "Experience__c": [Years of experience required as a decimal], "Name": [Job title], "Key_Responsibilities__c": [List of key responsibilities in string with comma separated], "Other_Location__c": [Other possible work locations, if mentioned], "Preferred_Location__c": [Preferred work location, if mentioned], "Required_Qualification__c": [Required degrees, certifications], "Skills__c": [Key skills mentioned in string with comma separated], "Time_Zone__c": [Time zone(s) mentioned], "Original_Description__c": [Full original job description text, don't change content, only remove extra space and ASCII characters and align], "Job_Opportunity": "[Insert the provided Job Opportunity Id]" }
If a field is not mentioned in the job description, return it as null.
Rules:
DO NOT add any extra text, explanations, warnings, suggestions, or notes outside of the JSON.
This is an email body — DO NOT use headers like "From", "To", or "Subject" as contact or company.
DO NOT use footer content as contact or company.
Only return raw JSON that can be used directly in Salesforce.
Do not wrap the output in json — return raw JSON only.
Please parse the following job description(s) accordingly: [INSERT JOB DESCRIPTION TEXT HERE]
